what: The Comedian's gags as numbers (Design round). GAGS.md is the page; this is the same thing for the behaviour data. Frames at 60 fps. kind: move | hold | laugh (the held beat that gets the laugh) | glitch (stepped at 12 fps, tagged). cooldown_s = least time between two plays. chance = odds per eligible trigger.
refusals_note: BOLD CHOICE (THE NO), one flag. true = about 1 trigger in 12 he declines the gag with the fixed three beats below. false = he always plays it.
